items.hook: Monument is a home rule town situated at the base of the Rampart Range in El Paso County, Colorado, United States.
items.body: Monument is one of the three communities that make up the Tri-Lakes area, along with Palmer Lake and Woodmoor. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Dee Molenaar was an American mountaineer, author and artist.
items.body: He is best known as the author of The Challenge of Rainier, first published in 1971 and considered the definitive work on the climbing history of Mount Rainier. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Arata Sonoda is a Japanese Greco-Roman wrestler.
items.body: He won one of the bronze medals in the 130 kg event at the 2018 Asian Games held in Jakarta, Indonesia. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: UK's 'dismal' Eurovision song choices to be examined by MPs
items.body: It comes after the UK's entry Look Mum No Computer came last in May's final, scoring just one point.

items.hook: Dragon's Teeth is a 1942 novel by Upton Sinclair that won the Pulitzer Prize for the Novel in 1943.
items.body: Set in the period 1929 to 1934, it covers the Nazi takeover of Germany during the 1930s. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.body: Their debut album, Moon Safari, including the track "Sexy Boy", was released in 1998. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
